_about: Published MBBS fees read by hand from official notices, one row per college and seat type. Amounts are rupees per year. Each source names the document it came from, so it can be checked again.

OR-2026.label: OJEE's Round 3 admission notice, 2026
OR-2026.title: OJEE, Schedule and Instructions for Provisional Admission to MBBS/BDS (3rd Round Counselling), 2026, section C, Fee structure
OR-2026.note: Government colleges: Rs. 37,950 per annum. NRI candidates pay four times the private college fee, as the notice states, so those rows are worked out from it.

PY-2026.label: Puducherry's fee order of 28 August 2026
PY-2026.title: Government of Puducherry, Chief Secretariat (Health), Order No.225/H5/Health-II/2026-27 dated 28.08.2026, Approved Fee Structure for UG Medical course, 2026-27 to 2028-29
PY-2026.note: Covers PIMS and SMVMCH. Sri Venkateshwaraa's fee is governed by a High Court interim stay, so it isn't listed.

UP-2026.label: UP's fee orders for 2026-27, on upneet.gov.in
UP-2026.title: Government of Uttar Pradesh, Chikitsa Shiksha Anubhag-4, fee fixation notifications for MBBS, academic session 2026-27, one per college (for example No. 175/71-4099/89/2026 dated 01.09.2026), published by DGME on upneet.gov.in as "Fee Fixation GO for Academic Session of UPNEET UG 2026-27 in MBBS Course"
UP-2026.note: Tuition fee only. Hostel, security deposit and other charges stay as in 2025-26. The documents open from the notices on the home page, which have no direct address. Prasad Medical College (Unnao), Radha Govind (Meerut) and Mayo (Barabanki) are in the orders but not on this site.

UP-MIN-2026.label: Minority colleges' fee statements, UP NEET UG 2026, on upneet.gov.in
UP-MIN-2026.title: UP NEET UG-2026 Fee Structure, Minority Private Medical Colleges, U.P., for MBBS Course: each college's letter to DGME (Teerthanker Mahaveer 11.08.2026, F.H. 07.08.2026, Career 06.08.2026, Era 10.08.2026)
UP-MIN-2026.note: Minority colleges set their own fee and declare it to DGME, which publishes the letters. Tuition fee only.

UP-IIMSR-2026.label: Integral's revised MBBS fee, UP NEET UG 2026, on upneet.gov.in
UP-IIMSR-2026.title: Integral Institute of Medical Sciences & Research, Ref. IIMSR/DO/2026/2740 dated 02.09.2026, Revised MBBS Fee Structure for NEET UG 2026-27, published by DGME on upneet.gov.in

UP-ESIC-2026.label: ESIC Noida and Varanasi fee structure, UP NEET UG 2026, on upneet.gov.in
UP-ESIC-2026.title: Fee Structure of ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Noida and Varanasi for UP NEET UG 2026-27, published by DGME on upneet.gov.in
UP-ESIC-2026.note: Tuition for state and All India quota seats. Insured-person (IP quota) seats pay Rs. 24,000, which the site has no seat type for.

MP-2026.label: DME Madhya Pradesh's college fee report, UG counselling 2026
MP-2026.title: Directorate of Medical Education, Madhya Pradesh, MP State Combined U.G. Counselling-2026, Subject Fee Details (UG) report, MBBS, all institutes
MP-2026.note: Tuition fee per year. Private colleges also charge a development and miscellaneous fee (about 15 to 18% of tuition) and a Rs. 25,000 caution deposit, which are left out. Government colleges also take Rs. 14,000 caution money (Rs. 5,000 at ESIC Indore). Read on 6 November 2026.

TN-2026.label: Tamil Nadu's MBBS/BDS prospectus 2026-27
TN-2026.title: Selection Committee, Directorate of Medical Education and Research, Tamil Nadu, Prospectus for admission to MBBS/BDS 2026-2027 session, section 22, Fee Structure (pages 55 to 58)
TN-2026.note: Government colleges: tuition Rs. 6,000 a year; with special, library, university and other fees the yearly total is Rs. 18,073. Self-financing colleges: the fee for a government quota seat as fixed by the Fee Committee. Management and NRI quota fees are in the separate management quota prospectus and aren't included.

TG-2026.label: Telangana's fee order for the 2026-29 block period, on knruhs.telangana.gov.in
TG-2026.title: KNRUHS notice dated 11.08.2026 on G.O.Ms.No.98, HM&FW (C1) Dept., dated 07.08.2026, which keeps the MBBS fees of G.O.Ms.No.106 dated 28.07.2023 (Annexure 1) and G.O.Ms.No.132 dated 18.08.2023 for the block period 2026-2029
TG-2026.note: Private colleges only. Category A (competent authority, filled by state counselling) is Rs. 60,000 a year everywhere and is listed as a government quota seat; Category B is the management quota. Category C (NRI) is only capped at up to 2 times Category B, so it isn't listed. Deccan's Category B fee is Rs. 13,90,000 by G.O.Ms.No.132. The annexure is scanned and was read by eye. Government colleges publish their own fees on their websites, so they aren't covered here.

RJ-PVT-2026.label: Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling Board, private college fees 2026
RJ-PVT-2026.title: MBBS Course (Private Medical Colleges) College Fee Details, Rajasthan NEET UG Admissions 2026, as provided by the respective medical college
RJ-PVT-2026.note: Tuition per year. The general seat is the state quota seat filled by counselling and is listed as a government quota seat. Colleges also charge a one-time caution money and admission fee and yearly other fees. The information bulletin says some private colleges' fees are before the Rajasthan High Court and Supreme Court, and American International's state quota fee is subject to the Fee Regulatory Committee's final decision.

RJ-GOVT-2026.label: Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling Board, government, RUHS and RajMES college fees 2026
RJ-GOVT-2026.title: MBBS Course (Govt. & Management Seats) College Fee Details, Rajasthan NEET UG Admissions 2026, under State Government order no. F.8(4)M.E./Group-1/2022 dated 30.09.2022, for Government, RUHS-CMS and Govt. Society RAJMES colleges, academic year 2026-27
RJ-GOVT-2026.note: Tuition Rs. 73,900 a year on a government seat and Rs. 10,05,100 on a management seat. Other yearly fees add Rs. 27,000, plus Rs. 30,600 one-time. Only RUHS and the RajMES society colleges have management seats. NRI seats are fixed in US dollars (USD 40,202.40 for the first year) by a separate order, so they aren't listed.

RJ-ESIC-2026.label: Rajasthan NEET UG Counselling Board, ESIC college fees 2026
RJ-ESIC-2026.title: MBBS Course (ESIC MC) College Fee Details, Rajasthan NEET UG Admissions 2026, as provided by the respective medical college
RJ-ESIC-2026.note: Tuition per year on a state quota seat at ESIC Alwar and ESIC Jaipur.

GJ-2026.label: Gujarat Fee Regulatory Committee (Medical), MBBS fees for 2025-26 and 2026-27
GJ-2026.title: Fee Regulatory Committee (Medical), Gujarat State, FRC/No/64/2025 dated 30.05.2025, Fee Structure for the year 2025-26 and 2026-27 (Rs. in lakhs), MBBS
GJ-2026.note: The fee for students admitted in 2026-27. Government seats are the state quota seats filled by ACPUGMEC; management seats are the rest. Covers 16 self-financed colleges and the municipal colleges NHL, Narendra Modi and SMIMER. Amounts are printed in lakhs to two decimals. The order is a scanned photo and was read by eye. NRI seats, GMERS colleges and state government colleges aren't covered.

GJ-BHAGYODAY-2026.label: Gujarat Fee Regulatory Committee (Medical), Bhagyoday Medical College order
GJ-BHAGYODAY-2026.title: Fee Regulatory Committee (Medical), Gujarat State, FRC/No/141/2025 dated 30.07.2025, Fee Structure for the year 2025-26 and 2026-27 (Rs. in lakhs), Bhagyoday Medical College, Kadi
GJ-BHAGYODAY-2026.note: The fee for students admitted in 2026-27. Scanned, read by eye.

AP-2026.label: Andhra Pradesh's interim fee order for 2026-27, on drntr.uhsap.in
AP-2026.title: Government of Andhra Pradesh, G.O.Rt.No.785, HM&FW (C1) Dept., dated 29.08.2026, Fixation of interim fee structure for the Academic Year 2026-27 tentatively for the UG Courses in Private Un-Aided Professional Medical and Dental Colleges
AP-2026.note: One fee for every private unaided college: Rs. 18,150 a year on an A-Category (competent authority quota) seat, listed as a government quota seat, and Rs. 14,52,000 on a B-Category (management quota) seat. C-Category (NRI) is only capped at Rs. 43,56,000, so it isn't listed. The fee is interim, 10% above 2025-26, and will be replaced when the fee commission fixes the final fee; the difference is then refunded or recovered. Court cases on the fee are pending. Government colleges aren't covered.

KL-2026.label: CEE Kerala, MBBS and BDS option registration notification, KEAM 2026
KL-2026.title: Commissioner for Entrance Examinations, Kerala, CEE/404/2026-TA4, Admission to MBBS and BDS Courses 2026, Online Options Invited: Fee in Government Colleges and Fee in Self Financing Medical Colleges
KL-2026.note: Government medical colleges: Rs. 23,150 a year. Self-financing colleges: a general (85%) seat fee, listed as a private seat, and an NRI (15%) seat fee. The self-financing fees are the 2025-26 fees, paid provisionally because the 2026-27 fee wasn't fixed yet; students pay any increase later. A government order of July 2026 limits fees to the 4.5 academic years of the course.

KL-PIMS-2026.label: CEE Kerala, first phase MBBS notification adding Palakkad Institute of Medical Sciences, KEAM 2026
KL-PIMS-2026.title: Commissioner for Entrance Examinations, Kerala, KEAM 2026 notification including Palakkad Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) in the MBBS allotment, with its provisional annual fee
KL-PIMS-2026.note: Annual fee (provisional): Rs. 8,98,800 for a general seat and Rs. 21,65,720 for an NRI seat.

BR-2026.label: BCECEB, Fee Structure of UGMAC-2026
BR-2026.title: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board, Fee Structure of UGMAC-2026: each college's letter to the Board giving its MBBS fee for 2026-27
BR-2026.note: Yearly tuition for a general (state counselling) seat, listed as a government quota seat; most colleges say it was fixed by Bihar's Educational Fee Fixation Committee (Shikshan Shulk Nirdharan Samiti) order of 10.09.2026 or 12.08.2026. Shrinivas's figure is marked as proposed, pending that committee. Katihar adds a Rs. 1,50,000 development fee, left out. Hostel, admission and deposit are extra. NRI fees are in US dollars, so they aren't listed. IGIMS's figure is its whole yearly fee. The document is scanned and was read by eye. Government colleges aren't in it.

CG-2026.label: Chhattisgarh Medical Education Department, interim MBBS fee revision of 23.09.2025
CG-2026.title: Government of Chhattisgarh, Medical Education Department, order No. STU-4702/10/2025-MED dated 23.09.2025: interim revision of MBBS fees for 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 under the Admission and Fee Regulatory Committee's resolution of 22.08.2024
CG-2026.note: Published on cgdme.in. One fee per student per year, inclusive of growth, development and other charges, for four years, with half for the last half year. It doesn't vary by seat type, so it's listed as a private seat. Interim. Shri Shankaracharya, RIMS and Maa Padmavati aren't covered.

HR-2026.label: UHSR Rohtak, provisional tuition fee for MBBS/BDS 2026-27
HR-2026.title: Pt. B.D. Sharma University of Health Sciences, Rohtak, Public Notice dated 02.09.2026: Provisional Tuition Fee for Admission to MBBS/BDS Courses for the Academic Session 2026-27
HR-2026.note: Provisional yearly tuition paid through the admission portal, one fee per college for every state counselling seat. NRI fees are fixed in US dollars, so they aren't listed. Maharishi Markandeshwar Mullana and Amrita Faridabad aren't in the notice.

PB-2026.label: BFUHS prospectus for MBBS/BDS 2026, state notification section 14 (Fee)
PB-2026.title: Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot, Prospectus for admission to MBBS/BDS courses, Session 2026, Part B: Government of Punjab admission notification, clause 14, Fee
PB-2026.note: The fee rises every year; the first-year fee is listed. Government colleges and government societies: Rs. 2,02,000 in the first year (Rs. 2,22,000, 2,44,000, 2,68,000 and 1,47,000 after). Private colleges: government quota (50%) Rs. 4,69,000 and management quota (35%) Rs. 12,06,000 in the first year. SGRD Amritsar charges Rs. 12,06,000 to all its students. NRI seats are US$1,10,000 for the whole course, so they aren't listed. CMC Ludhiana sets its own fee (Rs. 6.60 lakh a year with 10% yearly increases from an unstated base year), so it isn't listed. ESIC Ludhiana isn't covered. Subject to change by government notification.

UK-GOVT-2026.label: HNBUMU NEET UG 2026 counselling, government college fees and GO
UK-GOVT-2026.title: Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University, NEET UG 2026 State Counselling: Govt college Fee and GO (Government of Uttarakhand order No. 1076/XXVIII(5)/2021-77/2013 of December 2021, with each college's 2026-27 fee notice)
UK-GOVT-2026.note: Tuition Rs. 1,45,000 a year for a student who doesn't sign the compulsory state service bond; Rs. 50,000 for one who does. The bond-free fee is listed. Scanned, read by eye.

UK-PVT-2026.label: HNBUMU NEET UG 2026 counselling, private college fee notices
UK-PVT-2026.title: Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University, NEET UG 2026 State Counselling: college-wise fee details for HIMS (Swami Rama Himalayan University), SGRR and Gautam Buddha Chikitsa Mahavidyalaya, 2026-27
UK-PVT-2026.note: Tuition on an Uttarakhand quota seat (25-30% of seats, for permanent residents, after a 25% rebate), listed as a private seat, matching the counselling lists. All India open quota seats cost more: Rs. 24,00,000 at HIMS and SGRR and Rs. 21,00,000 at Gautam Buddha. NRI fees are in US dollars. Graphic Era's fee isn't on the portal. Scanned, read by eye.

HP-2026.label: AMRU Himachal Pradesh, prospectus for MBBS/BDS counselling 2026, Section X
HP-2026.title: Atal Medical and Research University, Himachal Pradesh, Prospectus for MBBS/BDS Counselling 2026, Section X: Fee Structure and Other Conditions
HP-2026.note: Government colleges: tuition Rs. 40,000 a year (Rs. 60,000 in the first year with other funds and deposit); no tuition for BPL students. MM Kumarhatti (Solan), first year: Rs. 8,47,000 on a state quota seat and Rs. 15,97,200 on a management seat, rising each year, set by the state in June 2023 and open to review. NRI fees are in US dollars. Tuition is charged for 4.5 years.

JH-LCMCH-2026.label: JCECEB, fee structure of Laxmi Chandravansi Medical College for 2026-27
JH-LCMCH-2026.title: Laxmi Chandravansi Medical College & Hospital, Bishrampur, Palamu, letter to the Government of Jharkhand dated 06.08.2026 on seats and fees for MBBS 2026-27, published by JCECEB
JH-LCMCH-2026.note: Tuition Rs. 13,25,000 a year for 4.5 years on Jharkhand-domicile and all-India seats. A development fee of Rs. 1,00,000 a year is extra. NRI seats are separate. Scanned, read by eye.

JH-SKMCH-2026.label: JCECEB, proposed fee structure of Sido Kanhu Medical College for 2026-27
JH-SKMCH-2026.title: Sido Kanhu Medical College & Hospital, Dumka, Proposed Fees Structure for MBBS Programme 2026-27 (17.07.2026), published by JCECEB
JH-SKMCH-2026.note: Proposed by the college: tuition Rs. 15,00,000 a year for 4.5 years on a management quota seat. NRI tuition is in US dollars.

JH-MTMC-2026.label: JCECEB, fee structure of Manipal Tata Medical College for 2026-27
JH-MTMC-2026.title: Manipal TATA Medical College, Jamshedpur, MBBS Admissions 2026-27: fee structure for the 25 seats filled through Jharkhand state counselling, published by JCECEB
JH-MTMC-2026.note: Rs. 12,69,000 per instalment for unreserved candidates and Rs. 8,46,000 for SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates, after the college's scholarship; four instalments for the course (Rs. 50,86,000 in all). The unreserved instalment is listed.
